name: Class reports - individual WhatsApp drafts (up to 45 students)

parameters.formDescription: Upload one class CSV (maximum 45 students). Review personalised homework, exam, and teacher concern messages before opening each parent's WhatsApp chat.

parameters.content:
## How to use
1. Execute workflow and open the teacher form.
2. Enter teacher details and upload examples/students.csv or your own CSV (up to 45).
3. Review each message and open its individual WhatsApp link.
4. Press Send in WhatsApp.

Example phone numbers are intentionally blank. Supply actual parent numbers with country codes. This workflow prepares drafts; it does not send or track delivery.
